body:
### Summary

When updating or bumping a version with `uv version` (e.g., `uv version --bump minor --locked`, or in CI environments where `UV_LOCKED=1` is set), `pyproject.toml` is written to disk before `lock_and_sync` executes.

If `lock_and_sync` fails—such as when `--locked` detects that `uv.lock` needs an update—the command aborts with an error, but `pyproject.toml` remains modified on disk.

This violates the expectation that `--locked` leaves project state untouched when lock validation fails, and leaves `pyproject.toml` desynchronized from `uv.lock`.

### Steps to Reproduce

```bash
# 1. Create a clean project with a lockfile
mkdir uv-version-repro && cd uv-version-repro
uv init --name demo
uv lock

# 2. Run uv version with --locked
uv version --bump minor --locked

# 3. Check git status
git status -s
```

### Expected Behavior

Because `--locked` was provided and the version change requires updating `uv.lock`, the command should abort without leaving changes on disk. `pyproject.toml` should remain at `0.1.0`.

### Actual Behavior

The command errors with:
```text
error: The lockfile at `uv.lock` needs to be updated, but `--locked` was provided. To update the lockfile, run `uv lock`.
```
However, `git status` shows `pyproject.toml` was already modified:
```diff
--- a/pyproject.toml
+++ b/pyproject.toml
@@ -3,3 +3,3 @@
 name = "demo"
-version = "0.1.0"
+version = "0.2.0"
```

### Root Cause

In `crates/uv/src/commands/project/version.rs`, line 334 calls `update_project` before `lock_and_sync`. Inside `update_project` (line 452), `fs_err::write(pyproject_path, &content)` writes the new `pyproject.toml` to disk before `LockOperation::execute` runs with `LockMode::Locked`.

When `LockOperation` returns an error at line 647, the command exits without reverting the file on disk. In contrast, `crates/uv/src/commands/project/add.rs` performs the lock check against the in-memory representation first and only writes to disk once `LockOperation` succeeds.

### Platform

Windows 11 x86_64, Linux x86_64

### Version

0.12.17

### Python version

Python 3.12
title: uv version modifies pyproject.toml on disk even when lock_and_sync fails (e.g., under --locked)
